scope: TEMP-only ranking comparison, frozen v3 inner solver and certificate machinery

rules.lcb: minimize m-sigma among cut-eligible candidates; original v3
rules.ei: maximize E[(T-F)+] with T=actual U-epsilon/2; zero sigma -> positive deterministic improvement
rules.guard: on a refreshed master prioritize its certified binary candidate; otherwise original LCB
rules.ei_guard: on a refreshed master prioritize its certified binary candidate; otherwise EI
rules.master: unchanged master-only baseline, not an acquisition-rule selection candidate

development: All 26 existing cases: two losses, D=6/8, n=4/8, seeds3/7/11, budget2; two D12 n4 seed3 budget3 cases

confirmation.startup: One explicit common data-screening support: top-d absolute class-mean differences divided by the sum of class standard deviations plus 1e-12. Stable ties. No retuning to tail startup after observing confirmation.

selection: Among the four rules with every development case certified optimal and reference-consistent, minimize total completed support evaluations, then total elapsed solve time, then master count. Freeze exactly one winner before running confirmation; no retuning from confirmation.
comparison: Same explicit data/seed and tolerances. Development uses the 26 known difficult tail-coordinate starts and rotates all five methods. Confirmation uses normal data-screening starts, compares the locked winner with LCB/master, and rotates order. All failures retained.
invariants: Every queried support binary and fully optimized
One final owned tangent per completed support
Only actual tests update U; valid global master bounds update LB
No repricing, inherited tests, new-point cuts, fractional inner calls
All acquisitions satisfy a <= U-epsilon/2 and accurate evaluations meet delta=epsilon/4
